title: fix(service-automation)!: a connector_action node refuses an input key its action does not declare
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DH9e4qEZ6HPSFPqXCYcdFui)_

Fixes #33553

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a `connector_action` step whose `connectorConfig.input` holds a key the chosen action's `inputSchema` does not declare used to run and send that key to the provider; it now fails before dispatch with `VALIDATION_ERROR`. Nothing published widens: `connector-input-schema.ts` is not re-exported from the package's `"."` entry, so `ConnectorInputJudgeOptions`, `UNDECLARED_KEY_HINT` and `undeclaredKey` are internal (the same spelling #27995 declared for this door). First-party flows affected: 0.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md (the `connector_action` row lists the judged subset without the undeclared-key refusal), skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md (says a skipped `$ref` makes the derived schema silently lose the parameter; it now reads as open input). Governed surface, so not in this PR.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`connector_action` 节点在调用连接器前,若 `connectorConfig.input` 里有该 action 的 `inputSchema` 未声明的键(任一对象层级,含数组元素),整步拒绝并报 `VALIDATION_ERROR`,点名节点、键和该层已声明的键,不再发给外部服务;同时 OpenAPI 连接器生成器把它读不懂的部分(未解析的 `$ref` 参数、`$ref` 或无 schema 的请求体)声明为开放,而不是漏掉。
- 为什么改:设计器切换连接器或 action 后残留的旧键会原样发到外部服务;而生成器若继续漏掉 `$ref` 参数,未规范化的 OpenAPI 文档上原本能用的调用会被新规则误拒。
- 风险与回滚:已存的流若带未声明键,运行时这一步会失败(fault 边可接);Slack `chat.postMessage` / `chat.update` 只列了 4 个参数,其它 Slack 参数需改用 `call` action(changeset 已写迁移)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts` 的 `buildInputSchema`(开放分节与 `body: {}`),再看 `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-input-schema.ts` 的 `declaredKeysOf`,最后 `.changeset/33553-connector-action-undeclared-input-key.md` 的迁移段。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-openapi exec vitest run src/input-schema-dispatch.test.ts`,预期 6 个用例全绿,其中 #33553 的 2 个证明带 `$ref` 参数/请求体的文档仍能调用。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `connector-input-schema.ts`: `judgeConnectorInput` takes an opt-in `refuseUndeclaredKeys`. With it on, at every object level the walk reaches (array items included), a key the schema does not declare is a violation naming its dotted path and the keys declared there (at most 8 listed, then a count). The verdict gains `undeclaredKey`, and the module exports `UNDECLARED_KEY_HINT` for the door's refusal.
- **Which schemas declare their keys**: a schema that lists `properties`, or says `additionalProperties: false`; the declared keys are the names in `properties` plus those in `required`. A schema that admits more keys declares OPEN input and every key dispatches: `additionalProperties` set to `true` or to a schema, `unevaluatedProperties` other than `false`, `patternProperties`, `$ref`, `$dynamicRef`, `$recursiveRef` (added in this round, review#2 N2), `allOf` / `anyOf` / `oneOf`, `if` / `then` / `else`, `dependentSchemas`, `dependencies`. A schema with no `properties` is open too, as is an action with no `inputSchema`.
- An undeclared key whose value is `undefined` is absent (never sent); every other value, `null` included, is refused.
- `builtin/connector-nodes.ts`: the `connector_action` node asks for the judgment on the EVALUATED input, against the schema of the instance the call dispatches to, and appends the hint. Same `VALIDATION_ERROR` runtime failure as a missing required parameter, so a `fault` edge receives it. No new error code.
- **`connector-openapi` `buildInputSchema` (review#2 M1, option a).** What the generator skips now reads as open, never as absent, because the handler still sends it. An unresolved `$ref` parameter has no readable `in` without de-referencing the document, so it opens every location the handler sends: `path`, `query` and `header` are each emitted with `additionalProperties: true`, also when they declare no parameter of their own (then not required). Parameters declared beside the `$ref` are still type-checked. An unresolved `$ref` request body, or one whose content carries no `schema`, is declared as `body: {}` (any value). A document run through `normalize-openapi` is unaffected and keeps full per-parameter checks.
- The connector pull door (`connector-pull.ts`, `connectorSource.input`) does not opt in and is unchanged in behaviour; it is now pinned through `pullConnectorSource` itself (review#2 N4).
- Changeset: lists `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/connector-openapi` and `@objectstack/spec` (review#2 N3; spec carries the semantic entry); names the Slack `chat.postMessage` / `chat.update` partial schemas with the FROM → TO migration to the `call` action (S2); says "every object level, array items included" (N1). The semantic entry's `surface` and `replacement` say the same.

### Why run time and not publish time

Measured on `origin/main` `4bba8b8f02` with a throwaway probe (not committed): the connector list read at the boot flow pull's `registerFlow` call was `[]`, and `["host_conn"]` once `bootstrap()` resolved. In `plugin.ts` the flow pull runs in `start()` before `materializeDeclaredConnectors(ctx, { fatal: true })`, and stored connector entries wait for `kernel:bootstrapped`, so a registration-time verdict would be one the same boot can contradict (AGENTS.md "Startup registry reads"). A publish-time warning would need a sealed connector vocabulary, which does not exist; not built here.

## Tests

- `service-automation` `src/builtin/connector-input-schema.test.ts`, describe 6: a top-level undeclared key (node, key and declared keys named; `fault` edge gets `VALIDATION_ERROR`; handler never called), a `null` undeclared value, a key outside an `additionalProperties: false` schema, a key inside an OpenAPI `query` section, an envelope evaluating to an undeclared key, five open-input schemas that still dispatch, a declared-only call, the helper's opt-in, and (this round) `$recursiveRef` / `$dynamicRef` read as open.
- `service-automation` `src/connector-pull.test.ts` (this round): the pull door, through `pullConnectorSource`, still sends an undeclared top-level key and an undeclared `query` key.
- `connector-openapi` `src/input-schema-dispatch.test.ts`, new top-level describe (this round), through a real boot (LiteKernel + AutomationServicePlugin + ConnectorOpenApiPlugin, recording `fetchImpl`): (1) a `PUT` with `$ref` path and query parameters and a `$ref` body: the schema has open `path` / `query` / `header` and `body: {}`, the call dispatches to `/pets/7?tag=dog...` with the body sent, and the declared `limit` is still refused as a string; (2) a body whose content has no `schema` is `body: {}`, required, and dispatches.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, not touched: Studio `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/connector-input-fields.ts` treats a schema as closed only when it says `additionalProperties: false`, so it still offers an extras repeater for keys the run now refuses (loudly). Follow-up card for the ui lane.
- Out of scope, not touched: the connector pull door judges `connectorSource.input` with the same function and does not ask for the undeclared-key judgment, so an undeclared key in a mapping's `connectorSource.input` still reaches the provider. Same family; needs its own card.
- ADR-0087: `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` → the changeset declares `registered connector-action-undeclared-input-key-refused`; the semantic entry is `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.connector-action-undeclared-input-key-refused.ts`.
- File surface widened this round to `packages/connectors/connector-openapi` (review#2 M1). No open PR touched that package when this was pushed (99 open PRs' file lists read).
- First-party producers checked against their action schemas: the shipped DocuSign and Stripe OpenAPI documents carry no `$ref` parameter or request body; showcase Slack `chat.postMessage` sends `channel`, `text`; showcase REST `request` and MCP `echo_upper` send declared keys only. GitHub MCP schemas come from the remote `tools/list` and were not measured.

## Verification
